name: validate-terminal-offset-fix
task_summary: Validate smallest safe fix design for xterm reactivation offset
description: Review minimal xterm offset fix design

spawn_spec.prompt:
Read-only technical review. Ferryx's terminal host manager resets a warm xterm instance and replays bounded output on reactivation; a later FitAddon resize can leave the visible terminal viewport one row shifted. Do not edit files or use browser/desktop automation. Inspect current `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.ts`, `terminalInstanceFactory.ts`, `terminalOutputScheduler.ts`, `TerminalPane.tsx`, and their tests. Determine the smallest correct code change and deterministic test that (a) realigns a reset/replayed terminal after reactivation/fitting, (b) does NOT force scroll-to-bottom during normal live output or deliberately user-scrolled scrollback, and (c) preserves LRU/inactive replay behavior. Return a concrete patch design with exact code insertion sites and explain ordering. Stop with a recommendation, not implementation.
